pr_body:
Case sensitivity options are an uncomfortable fit with a boolean setting - changing to enum.
Closes #63893
pr_title: Search - clean up case sensitivity option in term-based queries
pr_comment:
Thanks for the review, Mayya but closing in favour of https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/63926
Thanks for looking at that too!

review_comment:
Seems that in  `getPreferredName().toString()` ,`toString()` part  is redundant.  
Here and in other queryBuilers as well

I am wondering why we organize `case_sensitivity` options as parseFields,  why not just strings?
as `field_default` and `insensitive` are not field names, but rather field values?

Thanks, Mayya. I was just following the pattern from `collect_mode` in aggs which uses an enum. This all may be academic because we might be going with a simple boolean, pending discussion (addressed in alternative PR https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/63926 )
